questions: Is a route the same both ways, so Circle to Madina and Madina to Circle cost the same fare? Or should each direction be added as its own route?
If a passenger asks about two stops with no direct route between them, should the system just say there is no route? Or should it work out a trip that changes trotros and add up the fares?
Should only you and your staff be able to add routes and change fares, while passengers can only look up prices?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
